items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 28:1
items.html: Every Partzuf divides at the Chazeh [chest]: from the Chazeh upward is the discernment of Atzilut, and it is called vessels of the interior; and from the Chazeh downward is BYA: the middle third of Tifferet is Beriah, NHY are Yetzirah, and Malchut is Assiyah. And they are the vessels of the back. (Item 66).
